record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.original_question: Find a criterion stated purely in terms of a grading-restricted vertex algebra itself that guarantees complete reducibility of its modules.

evidence.quote: Problem 3.3. Find a criterion on a grading-restricted vertex algebra itself for the complete reducibility of modules.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $V = \bigoplus_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} V_{(n)}$ be a grading-restricted vertex algebra over $\mathbb{C}$; that is, $V$ is a $\mathbb{Z}$-graded vector space equipped with a vertex operator map $Y(\cdot,x): V \to (\operatorname{End} V)[[x,x^{-1}]]$, a vacuum vector $\mathbf{1} \in V_{(0)}$, and a conformal vector $\omega$ whose modes give a representation of the Virasoro algebra with $L(0)$ acting on $V_{(n)}$ by multiplication by $n$, satisfying the usual vertex algebra axioms together with the grading-restriction conditions $\dim V_{(n)} < \infty$ for all $n$ and $V_{(n)} = 0$ for $n$ sufficiently negative. A grading-restricted generalized $V$-module is a $\mathbb{C}$-graded $V$-module $W = \bigoplus_{h \in \mathbb{C}} W_{[h]}$ on which $L(0) - h$ acts locally nilpotently on $W_{[h]}$, with $\dim W_{[h]} < \infty$ for all $h$ and $W_{[h]} = 0$ when $\operatorname{Re}(h)$ is sufficiently negative.

Formulate a criterion expressed purely in terms of intrinsic data of the grading-restricted vertex algebra $V$ itself (its grading, vertex operators, vacuum, and conformal structure) which is necessary and sufficient to ensure that every grading-restricted generalized $V$-module is completely reducible, i.e., is isomorphic to a direct sum of irreducible grading-restricted generalized $V$-modules.
artifact.status_search_result: Cohomological sufficient criteria for complete reducibility of (lower-bounded / grading-restricted generalized) modules over a grading-restricted vertex algebra have been obtained, expressing reductivity via the vanishing of a first cohomology of V with coefficients in V-bimodules (Huang, 2018 and follow-ups). However, a fully intrinsic, easily checkable necessary-and-sufficient criterion stated purely in terms of the vertex algebra structure itself remains not established in full generality, so the problem is partially solved.

status_evidence.title: The first cohomology, derivations and the reductivity of a (meromorphic open-string) vertex algebra
status_evidence.snippet: A criterion for the complete reducibility of modules satisfying a composability condition is given using the first cohomology of the algebra.
status_evidence.claim: A cohomological sufficient condition for complete reducibility of modules over (grading-restricted) vertex algebras has been established, partially addressing the problem.

status_evidence.title: A cohomology theory of supercommutative algebras and grading-restricted vertex superalgebras
status_evidence.snippet: A cohomology theory has been constructed for grading-restricted vertex superalgebras, focusing on first and second cohomologies relevant to reductivity.
status_evidence.claim: Ongoing work continues to develop intrinsic cohomological tools for studying complete reducibility of modules over grading-restricted vertex (super)algebras.
